```python
    def dijkstra(self, s, pi):
        to = self.to; cap = self.cap; cost = self.cost; adj = self.adj
        n = self.n
        dist = [None]*n; prevv = [-1]*n; preve = [-1]*n

            base = du + pi[u]

                dv = dist[v]
                if dv is None or nd < dv:
                    dist[v] = nd; prevv[v] = u; preve[v] = ei
                    push(hq, (nd, v))
 return dist, prevv, preve
```
